---
title: "Semester pacing: Modules 1–7"
---

This page schedules the currently implemented material within a 14–16 week semester. It does not create placeholder lessons for future modules.

| Week | Preparation (60–90 min) | Class meeting (150–180 min) | Product |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Setup and reproducibility reading | Environment clinic; R sparse-matrix refresher | Verified local environment |
| 2 | Module 1 through matrix anatomy | Droplets, barcodes, reads, UMIs, cell/gene access patterns | Matrix anatomy worksheet |
| 3 | Module 1 zeros and artifacts | Undersampling lab; ambient RNA, empty droplets, doublets | Sampling-zero explanation |
| 4 | Module 2 metrics | QC plots by cell and sample; complexity interpretation | QC figure set |
| 5 | Module 2 thresholds | Threshold sensitivity lab; population retention analysis | QC decision table |
| 6 | Module 2 downstream consequences | PCA/clustering comparison and biological discussion | QC sensitivity report |
| 7 | Module 3 through hand calculations | Library-size correction and log transformation | Hand-calculation worksheet |
| 8 | Module 3 perturbations | Raw/normalized comparison and scale-factor exercise | Normalization interpretation memo |
| 9 | Module 3 model-based section | Optional SCTransform comparison; foundational synthesis | Foundational analysis audit |
| 10 | Module 4 | Mean–variance calculations and HVG comparisons | Feature-selection report |
| 11 | Module 5 scaling | Manual scaling and reference-population comparison | Scaling worksheet |
| 12 | Module 5 regression | Controlled regression and biological consequences | Regression decision memo |
| 13 | Module 6 geometry | Loadings, scores, orthogonality, and reconstruction | PCA arithmetic |
| 14 | Module 6 interpretation | Loading programs and T-cell subset comparison | PC evidence table |
| 15 | Module 7 | Dimension sensitivity at fixed resolution | Cluster stability report |
| 16 | Cross-module synthesis | Justify the full representation workflow | Reproducible analysis narrative |

For 14 weeks, combine Weeks 1–2 and Weeks 8–9 while retaining the stated independent lab time. No later module is required.
